hook: Benny sleeps outside a store the night before G T A 6. The reason will surprise you.
chosen_hook_alternatives: Nobody talks about this part of the GTA 6 wait.
Here is what the GTA 6 wait is secretly doing to you.
angle: Honest claim only: people who planned a vacation were happier before it than people who did not; after the trip, no overall difference. Waiting can feel good. Study is about trips, not games; said aloud.

facts.claim: 1,530 Dutch adults; 974 took a vacation. Vacationers were happier than non-vacationers before the trip (anticipation suggested). After the trip overall no difference; a very relaxing trip gave a small boost, gone after eight weeks.
Nawijn, Marchand, Veenhoven, Vingerhoets (2010), Applied Research in Quality of Life 5(1) 35-47, DOI 10.1007/s11482-009-9091-9.

twist: No big difference after the trip, plus the honest limit: trips, not games.
open_loop: Why could tonight be the best part? Paid off at lines 5-7.
ab_ending: A: The wait / B: The game. Comment bait, no right answer.
ip_notes: No Rockstar characters, logos, footage, art or music; 'GTA 6' plain text only. Store door is generic, no sign.
unverified: Whether the effect applies to video game launches (no study found)
Exact happiness scores/effect sizes (not on pages opened)
